bundle.longDescription: CleanReach is a free, open-source contact hygiene studio: import a messy CSV or text list, extract emails and phones, remove duplicates and disposable/temp addresses, classify every address into honest lanes (clean personal/corporate, role accounts, free-provider risky, disposable, invalid, unknown), validate GB/US/CA phone numbers, check domain health (MX/SPF/DMARC), and export clean lists plus a consented-phones lane for opt-in messaging. Everything runs on your own device — your list never leaves your machine. Free and open source (MIT).
bundle.shortDescription: Clean, verify and classify email/phone lists locally: disposable remover, honest lanes, phone validator.
